QUOTE: "Writes are refused on a stale process. `stale_code_refusal()` must be called before any write path touches an index. It has no override, and `force` does not bypass it."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that writes are refused (not warned) and that force cannot bypass the refusal. It also says the refusal is checked before any write path touches an index, which covers the placement ahead of the build decision.
